grudge_levies.name: A grudge against the deserters
grudge_levies.text: They will pay for the ridge.

grudge_sea.name: A grudge against the Sea
grudge_sea.text: Something with too many joints owes a debt.

heresy.name: A heresy
heresy.text: The gods answer through the Temple, and the Temple lies.

debt.name: A debt to collect
debt.text: The Tin Road driver promised payment at the next market.

fear_of_water.name: A fear of water
fear_of_water.text: The tide got into the boots and never left.

hunger_for_bronze.name: A hunger for bronze
hunger_for_bronze.text: The arm the smith took was the wrong one.
